name: research-workflow-desktop
description: Desktop and Android builds of Research Workflow
author: Murilo Oliveira de Araujo

scripts.dist: npm run icons && npm run web && electron-builder
scripts.dist:mac: npm run icons && npm run web && electron-builder --mac
scripts.dist:win: npm run icons && npm run web && electron-builder --win
scripts.dist:linux: npm run icons && npm run web && electron-builder --linux
scripts.android: npm run web && cap sync android
scripts.dist:android: npm run android && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease
